findings.claim: Kiro row 'hint only (no rewrite, no replace) / documented gap' breaks the owner MUST that large output never enters any subagent context, and drops the deny Kiro supports.
findings.evidence: spike-hooks-verified.md:39 'any non-zero blocks Pre/Prompt with stderr'; v1 hooks/kiro/pretooluse.mjs:33-49 maps deny and modify to exit 2.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 98f0025f 2026-03-16 'feat(kiro): add hook support for Kiro CLI (Phase 2)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT: '// Kiro CLI cannot modify tool input — deny with redirect message'. REGRESSION_RISK: hint-only lets big Bash/fs_read output reach Kiro subagents and the main session. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: keep the exit-2 deny with an alternative the caller can run.
findings.fix: Kiro Case A = yes (deny via exit 2). Cases B/C = deny naming an alternative the subagent has. State how a Kiro subagent is detected, or treat every Kiro call as Case A/C. Remove 'documented gap'.
